_comment: Test corpus for /library/iterate-skill and skill-bundle regression tests. Each entry maps a citekey to its genre, the subskill it's most representative for, and the memos that established it as a regression case. Cite the memo files in .virgil/memos/ for the specific failure mode each paper guards against.

_genres.scanned-ocr: OCR'd book or pre-2000 article scan; heading mis-promotion, drop caps, fix_italic_numerals, decode_caesar_pdf, recover_low_confidence_pgmarks.
_genres.journal-article-offset-pagination: PDF starts at the article's first printed page (pp. 19-39 in a 23-page PDF). Triggers `pgmark_validate.py --journal-cumulative`; tests the AND-of-range-and-span fix in pgmark_validate.
_genres.book-endnote-style: End-of-book Notes section with chapter sub-dividers or page-hint format. Tests reattach_page_hint_endnotes / reattach_unified_chapter_notes.
_genres.formal-semantics-paper: Davidson / Schlenker family with OCR-mangled lambda calculus and Heim-Kratzer brackets. Tests mathify_formal_semantics.
_genres.diagram-heavy-book: Venn-diagram logic books, payoff-matrix philosophy. Tests detect_garbage_headings + strip_ocr_headings + detect_diagram_book_garbage_headings.
_genres.dissertation: OCR'd thesis with no-separator footnotes and OCR-spaced headings. Tests split_leaked_footnotes + promote_lost_subsections + rewrite_citations(--style=bracket-numeric).
_genres.annual-reviews-paper: Annual Reviews journal article with margin glossary and post-article TOC pages. Tests detect_journal_toc + consolidate_margin_glossary.
